nodes.label: FMU export capability (CH_ENABLE_FMU_EXPORT)
nodes.rationale: FMU export is force-disabled unless Chrono is built statically (BUILD_SHARED_LIBS off) and, on MSVC, with a statically-linked runtime (CH_USE_MSVC_STATIC_RUNTIME). An FMU must be a self-contained shared object, so any Chrono runtime dependency it would otherwise inherit from a shared build would not be resolvable inside the importing tool.

nodes.label: fmu-forge third-party distribution
nodes.rationale: Defaults to the src/chrono_thirdparty/fmu-forge submodule but is overridable via FMU_FORGE_DIR so users can point at their own fmu-forge tree; the whole directory is installed under include/chrono_thirdparty because the FMI import/export headers are header-only wrappers over it.

nodes.label: FMI2/FMI3 platform triple detection
nodes.rationale: FMI 2.0 and FMI 3.0 name the binary platform differently (win64 vs x86_64-windows), so the module derives both FMI2_PLATFORM and FMI3_PLATFORM from WIN32/APPLE/UNIX plus CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P and exposes them as public compile definitions; when detection fails the values become user-editable cache entries instead of aborting the build.
